reviews.title: Flybosnia has never issued my refund!
reviews.text: My booking for April 2020 was cancelled due to covid-19. Since then, I was reassured number of timer that I will get my money back in couple of months. It’s July 2022 and still nothing. I don’t think I will ever see my money again.
reviews.author: Zana Y

reviews.title: THEY DON’T GIVE MONEY BACK
reviews.text: I am waiting for refund of my money ONE YEAR. I want to send them on the court. If you want to send them to the court contact me. Ova firma KRADE NOVAC !!! Svi koji putujete imajte na umu da Vam neće vratiti novac. Godinu dana mi šalju mailove da sam na listi. Fly Bosnia se bavi kriminalnom i krađom novca. Ukoliko želite da ih tužite javite mi se. Ova firma zaslužuje NULU ! Ujedinimo se svi da ovaj kriminal prestane !!!
reviews.author: Ajla S

reviews.title: Never had a refund for thir flight cancelation
reviews.text: The flight was canceled in March 20 due to the pandemic. They could not offer open tickets for the same destination as they stopped operating on this route. I requested a refund in March 20. Now it is May 21 and I still did not get my money back. I contacted them a lot of times through email and calls, all they say is I am on the list. Still on the list after 14 months!!!!
reviews.author: Az G

reviews.title: Very Useful
reviews.text: My family is Bosnian and we live in the UK. I usually go to Bosnia 3x a Year. I always have to connect, and it always wastes my time. When I found out Flybosnia was starting flights to London, I immediately checked the tickets and they were very pricey. I waited a bit and they had changed their prices to €90 ( with only a hand carry on). For a checked bag it was €121 euros. And for 2 checked pieces of checked baggage, it's around €160. Our flight was delayed by an hour, due to the weather a Sarajevo. We got on the plane and it was clean, tidy and comfortable. When we were at our cruising altitude. The crew started serving drinks and snacks ( which are free). I got a Turkish coffee and some chocolate biscuits and Some peanuts. We started our descent and landed smoothly. Overall experience was good, would definitely fly with them again. Though there are still some improvements needed. Eg: Customer Service
reviews.author: MarkoD

reviews.title: Did not get refund for the cancelled flight 4 months ago
reviews.text: They have cancelled our return route of the flight and we have chosen the refund option. That was in january. Since then, I am communicating with them in order to get that refund they say they have sent the money, but that the bank is at fault. At the moment, I am in a process of reporting them to regulatory agency
reviews.author: Aida H

reviews.title: Refund Process
reviews.text: They cancelled flight and after that offered opened ticket, when I ask for request they avoided refund my money insistently, I have been waiting more than 3 weeks about refund , they just e-mail me and they are really appreciate for my understanding!!!
reviews.author: Ahmet T U

reviews.title: Be wary of booking this airline
reviews.text: I booked a return journey to Sarajevo on 6th January.Yesterday I received an email from the airline advising that the flight on March 21 had been cancelled for operational reasons.The first time this has ever happened to me.I was offered a flight 3 days later or a refund.I chose a refund.I am lucky that I booked my hotel with Booking.com so I could cancel at no cost.So be very wary about booking this airline.Unfortunately they are the only airline flying direct to Sarajevo.
reviews.author: wingate
